items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: Helper functions shared by FTDS components, chiefly clx for joining and merging Tailwind classes with FTDS tokens. Imported from @/lib/ftds/utils.

items.name: hooks
items.title: Hooks
items.description: React hooks shared by FTDS components: toasts, the theme, media queries, copy to clipboard, countdowns, pagination and state helpers. Imported from @/lib/ftds/hooks.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A short modal message with a status icon and one or two actions. Use it to confirm a high-stakes or destructive action, or to report a result the user must acknowledge.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo in a circle, falling back to their initials while the image loads or if it fails. AvatarGroup overlaps several, such as a case's officers.

items.name: backlink
items.title: Backlink
items.description: A "Back" link with an arrow that takes the user to the previous step of a multi-page flow. Place it at the top of the page, above the heading.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links showing where the current page sits in the site's hierarchy, with the current page last. Quiet navigation at the top of content pages.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action or submits a form. One primary (blue) button per screen; tonal secondary, ghost and danger variants for everything else.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: A wash-coloured message with an icon for information, success, a warning or an error about the current page or task. It can carry an action and be dismissed.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content on its own surface, white on the page or Well for secondary content, with no border or shadow. Has header, content and footer parts.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A single tick box for a yes or no answer that is sent with a form, such as a declaration or consent. Put it in a Field with its label beside it.

items.name: cookie-banner
items.title: Cookie Banner
items.description: A panel in the bottom-right corner that asks for consent to non-essential cookies, with an optional preferences view. Show it until the user makes a choice.

items.name: details
items.title: Details
items.description: A link-like toggle that reveals a short piece of help, such as "Help with your IC number". Use it for information only some users need.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page for a short task that needs the user's full attention, such as editing details or reviewing before submitting. Focus stays inside until it closes.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps one form control with its label, hint and error message, and wires them together for assistive technology. Use it around every input.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related fields under one legend, such as an address or a question answered with radios or checkboxes. Disabling it disables every field inside.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The plain government footer every service needs: one band with the copyright line, an optional "last updated" note and the required links.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A form element that collects and validates the Fields inside it, and shows server errors on the right fields. Use it for any page that submits answers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field, with optional icons inside it and add-ons (such as "https://") joined to its edges. Always place it in a Field.

items.name: inset-text
items.title: Inset Text
items.description: Sets a passage apart from the text around it, such as a deadline, a requirement or a quote, on a grey Well with no icon.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Shows a keyboard shortcut as key caps in the platform's notation (mod+k reads ⌘K on macOS, Ctrl K elsewhere), and is read aloud as words.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A plain text label tied to a control with htmlFor. Only for controls outside a Field; inside a Field use FieldLabel.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A styled anchor for links in text and lists, with options for colour, underline and opening in a new tab. Pass render to use your router's link.

items.name: masthead
items.title: Masthead
items.description: The "Official Malaysia Government Website" bar at the very top of every government site, with a panel that explains how to tell the site is genuine.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions that opens from a button: row actions in a table, an account menu, a "More" overflow. Items run an action or go to a page; they don't choose a value.

items.name: phase-banner
items.title: Phase Banner
items.description: A slim bar under the masthead that says a service is in Alpha or Beta (or under maintenance) and asks for feedback.

items.name: pill
items.title: Pill
items.description: A removable tag with a ✕, for an applied filter, a chosen recipient or a selected option. For a status label that can't be removed, use Tag.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small floating panel anchored to its trigger, opened by a click. Use it for short help or a few controls that don't need a full dialog.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A group of radio buttons for choosing exactly one option from a short list that people should see all at once. Label the group with a Fieldset legend.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A fixed-size region with native scrolling and a thin scrollbar that shows only on hover or while scrolling. Use it for long lists inside panels, sidebars and dialogs.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one option, or several with multiple, from a list that opens below a field-like trigger. Pass items for a plain list or compose the parts for groups.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A single hairline between two groups of content, horizontal or vertical. Lines must earn their place; reach for spacing and tone first.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading, so the layout doesn't jump when the data arrives.

items.name: skiplink
items.title: Skiplink
items.description: A "Skip to main content" link that stays hidden until it gets keyboard focus. Put it first on every page so keyboard users can jump past the masthead and navigation.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small spinning ring for a short wait on one action, such as a button that is submitting. It has no accessible name, so pair it with text.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off straight away, with no submit step, such as email reminders. For a choice saved with a form, use a Checkbox.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of the same subject on one page, such as a case's details, documents and history. One underline style, with optional icons and counts.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A small wash label for the status or category of an item, such as Paid, In review or Overdue. The words carry the meaning, never colour alone.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Text Area
items.description: A multi-line text field for longer answers, such as the reason for an appeal. Place it in a Field; use CharacterCount when the answer has a limit.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: A button or select that switches between light and dark themes through ThemeProvider. Put it in the top bar or a settings page.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message in the corner of the screen that confirms something just happened, such as "Draft saved". Mount AutoToast once and call useToast().toast() anywhere.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A segmented control: a short row of Toggles where one, or several with multiple, is pressed. Use it to switch a view or filter, like Day, Week, Month.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed until pressed again, such as Bold in an editor toolbar or a "Show archived" filter. Inside a ToggleGroup it becomes a segment.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short text label that appears when a control is hovered or focused. Use it to name icon-only buttons or show a keyboard shortcut, never for information people need.
